svg.title: Use a local LLM directly or through an agent harness
svg.desc: A script sends an interview excerpt to a local LLM runtime and saves the label and supporting passage with the excerpt ID. A second route uses the same runtime with an agent harness. The harness runs permitted tools and sends their results back to the LLM.

g.text: On an approved computer or server
Two ways to use an LLM runtime

svg.text: Script saves the label and supporting
The runtime generates responses; the harness carries out actions
Configure tool access separately from local LLM execution
